messages.subject: Model replicate "sensu" MaxEnt.jar ?
parts:
Since Wallace use the .jar implementation of MaxEnt (along with the Maxnet) i was wondering if i can pass to the arguments a way to have a e.c. 5 replicate run for each model (l,q,h,p and regularization values from 1 to 5).


Or am missing something which is related to the ENMeval tool?

messages.author: d73691b565754184
messages.subject: Re: Model replicate "sensu" MaxEnt.jar ?
parts:
Hi Dimitris,

This option is not available on Wallace. You can use the parameter 'userArgs' in the ENMevaluate function. To fill this parameter, you need to use the same structure as the dismo package. I'm sure that this tread is useful if you want to explore this option (maxent group). BTW, I'm not sure if this can work, I never tried.

Best,
Gonzalo
